plan.notes: Official Rio Hondo College Guided Pathways sample education plan (pathways.riohondo.edu), 2026-2027 catalog year. The page's main sample plan is used (Rio Hondo College GE pattern); the alternate Cal-GETC map in the page's dropdown is not modeled. Term-by-term sequence transcribed from the published program map. Total 61.5 units = sum of published pathway slots. CD 228 (Early Childhood Education Practicum) carries an official course prerequisite: CD 106, CD 110, CD 111, CD 114 and CD 208, plus verification of immunizations against influenza, pertussis, and measles and freedom from tuberculosis for the lab requirement. CD 106 is the former course number of CDEV C1000 (in-plan, formerly CD 106); the prereq is modeled with the in-plan course codes, and the immunization verification is a non-course requirement noted here rather than modeled. PSY 190 carries a placement-based prerequisite in its official description (enrollment placement based on high school GPA/other measures, or completion of a pre-statistics or intermediate algebra course) — not modeled as a course prereq. All other fixed courses on this map list only Advisories in their published descriptions; remaining prereq arrays are intentionally empty — see the official catalog's course descriptions. Dagger (†): some classes may carry higher units; slots encoded at published values. Choice slots model the official 'Select one' requirements; see choice notes.
